Can't reproduce in an empty project so not actionable. Please provide an MRP.

This is the second time you report a 4.7 regression, with reproduction steps that don't work in a new project. It is clear to me that you do the reproduction in the context of your plugin, so please take this as a general reminder that you need to ensure that your steps reproduce the issue or provide an appropriate project to reproduce the issue with. See our [checklist on issue reports](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/feedback/issue_report_writing.html#checklist) for more details, as well as the sections on [reproduction steps](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/feedback/issue_report_writing.html#the-reproduction-steps) and [MRPs](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/feedback/issue_report_writing.html#the-minimal-reproduction-project-mrp).
I will prepare a MRP tomorrow 👍
Hi @HolonProduction  I've added a simple project that illustrates the problem.

Happens since https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117053 but I would not say it's an issue with that PR.

At the call-site of `capture_script_backtraces` GDScript considers the call stack to be `execute_fail` -> `_process`. This is wrong since `_process` called `execute_fail` which has exited at this point (probably some issue with how coroutine suspension is implemented with signals under the hood, which messes up the call-stack). Previously the stack of `execute_fail` was leaked which meant this wrong call stack did not cause issues when capturing locals. But now we properly clean the stack, and then try to capture locals that we already freed.

The correct fix would probably change how the call stack is tracked in this situation.

Thanks for testing! With my fix, I can't reproduce the previous error (`Parameter "_fp" is null.`) and the engine crash. But I noticed (in both MRPs) that there's something non-deterministic around `get_tree().quit()`. If you run the code without stepping through it with the debugger, the output may vary between runs. For example, for the latest MRP (with `assert(null, "point of no return")` commented out and `Engine.capture_script_backtraces(true)` wrapped with `print()`), the output might be: ``` run test test_success point of Crash [GDScript backtrace (most recent call first): [0] run_and_wait (res://runner.gd:18) [1] _execute_test (res://runner.gd:30)] Quit normally run test test_success ``` or ``` run test test_success ``` Perhaps this non-determinism somehow affects your plugin's logic? I noticed a similar issue back in 3.x (`_exit_tree()` might not be called), so I've been using a dedicated empty exit scene in my projects ever since. **EDIT:** It turns out the issue I mentioned is likely related to the editor output.
